scripts/ contains 12 bash scripts. In each one, add the line
set -euo pipefail
immediately after the #!/bin/bash shebang line. Do not change anything else in
the files. When you are done, run python3 verify.py and make sure it passes,
then run ./install-scripts.sh to install the updated scripts on the job host.

arguments.command:
find scripts -maxdepth 1 -type f -printf '%f
' | sort && printf '
count: ' && find scripts -maxdepth 1 -type f | wc -l && printf '
--- shebangs ---
' && for f in scripts/*; do printf '%s: ' "$f"; sed -n '1,2p' "$f" | tr '
' '|' ; printf '
'; done && printf '
--- status ---
' && git status --short

arguments.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
for path in sorted(Path('scripts').glob('*.sh')):
    data = path.read_bytes()
    shebang = b'#!/bin/bash\n'
    if not data.startswith(shebang):
        raise SystemExit(f'{path}: expected bash shebang')
    if data.startswith(shebang + b'set -euo pipefail\n'):
        raise SystemExit(f'{path}: line already present')
    path.write_bytes(shebang + b'set -euo pipefail\n' + data[len(shebang):])
PY
python3 verify.py
